display: kernel-v1 strict TS baseline (eBPF Runtime Security & Observability)
_comment: Strict TypeScript baseline consumed by web/tsconfig.json (task 44+) and
by any future generated TS client (task 6 proto-gen + task 35 typed RPC).
The flags below are non-negotiable for the plan (task 4 / wave 5):
* strict + noImplicitAny     — no production any (matches biome rule)
* noUncheckedIndexedAccess  — every arr[i]/map[k] is T | undefined
* exactOptionalPropertyTypes — undefined vs missing are not the same
* noFallthroughCasesInSwitch — explicit break/return at every case
* noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature — must use ['key'] for index sigs
* strictBindCallApply        — bind/call/apply honour their arg types
* isolatedModules            — every file is independently transpilable
The `quality:web` task in devenv.nix runs `bunx tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit`
against the per-app tsconfig.json that extends this file.
